g.text: Mean over all 1,800 NEU-DET images (train + locked-test folders). Real Qiskit FRQI/NEQR circuits, Qiskit-Aer statevector, multinomial shot sampling,
project decoder. NEQR saturates at its 4-bit quantisation error.
